title: Test Plan Re-check Sidecar
description: The re-checks of a flow-testing test plan's not_tested entries, kept beside the plan as {id}.recheck.json so the plan bytes, and so its approval digest, never change; a plan never stores a re-check of its own. Written only by flow-testing/scripts/test-plan-recheck.sh; shown by render-md.sh --recheck-file beside the entry each names. A record is shown beside, and refuses a second re-check of, only the not_tested entry whose digest equals its entry_sha256, so an amendment that renumbers or changes the entry never moves a re-check onto another. A pending record (the entry is being looked at again) is replaced by the entry's next re-check; an outcome — survived, cleared or escalated — is recorded once. An escalated entry is closed by the human with a second record after it, dismissed (test-plan-recheck.sh --recheck dismissed --reason), whatever the entry's category: the entry is kept untested, rendered "Kept untested by you — <reason>", and no longer needs the human's decision. Rules JSON Schema cannot express — one re-check per entry (by entry_sha256), except an escalated one followed by its dismissal, the proof form, a calendar-valid recorded date — are enforced by flow-testing's scripts/lib/test-plan-validate.jq (recheck_sidecar_errors); the proof naming a real file line or a test the plan holds, by test-plan-recheck.sh.

plan.description: The id of the test plan these re-checks belong to.

not_tested.description: The entry's number in render-md.sh's Not tested list (numbered on after the tests and the rejected proposals) when the re-check was recorded.

what.description: The entry's what when the re-check was recorded.

entry_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the re-checked entry as `jq -S -c` prints it, with waived_by_human and waiver_reason removed: the key the re-check is matched to its entry by. Its first 12 hex digits are the entry's handle (test-plan-recheck.sh --list-not-tested), which test-plan-recheck.sh and test-plan-amend.sh --waive-not-tested take as --expect-sha.

proof.description: Present exactly when status is survived or cleared: the evidence of the outcome from a reviewer or the review-arbiter, one line naming a file:line whose file is path-like (an extension or a "/", or Makefile, Dockerfile, Justfile, Rakefile, Gemfile, Procfile; never a URL or a bare number like 10:30) under test-plan-recheck.sh's --repo-root with that line, or a test number the plan holds; never a "ran " form.

reason.description: Present exactly when status is escalated or dismissed, one line of at most 200 characters in plain words: for escalated, why the re-check escalated the entry to the human (the verifier's or the adversary's unresolved disagreement); for dismissed, the human's reason for keeping the entry untested, in their words.
